variants.suspected_cause: The inherited record view places state30 at byte 30, while the observed field access is at offset 0x30; the accessed tail members must retain the observed 0x2c and 0x2e offsets and the 0x34 stride.
variants.controlled_change: Move the record view's two accessed initial words and state field to the offsets measured in this function, preserving the record's 0x34-byte stride.

predicted_effect.note: Changing field offsets alters encoded displacements without changing operand widths or the record stride.
